_comment: Immediate ack posted by scripts/ack_new_topic.py when a new RAGE ticket is picked up. Races ahead of the Claude topic agent so the user sees a response within seconds. The full review follows. TOPIC_ID (= thread_id = root message id) is printed so a developer can hand it to another agent, which then drives the topic per reference/agent-topic-reply.md (DESIGN §1.25).

content.text: 🤖 自动化 Review 已收到
⚠️注意：本次审查将仅针对上述MR，如果同一工单还会发起其他MR，请在本次审查结束后（合并结束或者关闭），重新使用Jira单号发起审查。
（把它交给其他 agent，即可让它代你在本话题回复）
